name: Scott Moulton
biography: is a data recovery specialist and forensic expert out of Atlanta at My Hard Drive Died where he uses his forensics experience to recover hard drives. Currently Scott Moulton is teaching classes on physically rebuilding damaged hard drives for SANS in a course titled SEC606 Forensic Data Recovery.
